CoreCSharp11MegaStress.cs
  Main positive runtime fixture. Compile as its own executable with C# 11 language mode and unsafe enabled.

FileScopedNamespaceFixture.cs
  Separate executable fixture for C# 10 file-scoped namespace syntax.

TopLevelStatementsFixture.cs
  Separate executable fixture for C# 9 top-level statements.

CrossFilePartial.Part1.cs + CrossFilePartial.Part2.cs
  Compile together as one library/executable dependency fixture to test partial type merging across source files.

Output convention
  TRACE|...      deterministic execution trace
  FINALIZER|...  finalizer trace; order/timing is runtime-defined in standard C#

Intentional exclusion
  No using directives.
  No async/await/threading/lock/concurrency tests; those belong in the separate threading fixture.
